brief: AI didn't kill my job — it made me realize I hated my job. 6 reframes for technical founders.

slots.subtitle: Six reframes for technical founders who built careers on craft and now feel stuck.
slots.preview1: Why being technical is now a liability
slots.preview2: The ownership gap nobody warned you about
slots.preview3: From code monkey to product owner

slots.title: Stop writing
slots.subtitle: AI generates working code in seconds, so your value is no longer syntax.
slots.insight1Body: ChatGPT and Claude ship boilerplate faster than any human.
slots.insight2Body: Founders who design systems—not snippets—will own the outcome.
slots.insight3Body: The best engineers now audit, edit, and approve rather than author.
slots.pullQuote: I spent ten years perfecting recursion; now I spend ten minutes reviewing it.

slots.title: Build solutions
slots.subtitle: Users pay for pain relief, not your elegant stack.
slots.insight1Body: Technical founders ship to prove skill, not to solve suffering.
slots.insight2Body: If you can't articulate the customer's headache, you're just decorating.
slots.insight3Body: AI lets you build ten times more; discipline lets you ship the right one.
slots.pullQuote: I was building a masterpiece that nobody asked for.

slots.title: Talk more
slots.subtitle: The highest-paid technical founders are translators, not typists.
slots.insight1Body: Headphones-on deep work feels safe, but it starves your company.
slots.insight2Body: A one-page strategy doc moves teams faster than a thousand commits.
slots.insight3Body: Investors and customers buy clarity; they don't read your pull requests.
slots.pullQuote: My best commit this quarter was a memo, not a merge.

slots.title: Ship ugly
slots.subtitle: Perfect code that ships next quarter loses to learning competitors.
slots.insight1Body: Your refactoring plan means nothing if the market moves on.
slots.insight2Body: Let machines clean up; your job is to find product-market fit.
slots.insight3Body: Momentum compounds faster than technical debt in early-stage companies.
slots.pullQuote: If you aren't embarrassed by v1, you let perfection steal your paycheck.

slots.title: Own the upside
slots.subtitle: AI revealed the truth: you hated renting your brain by the hour.
slots.insight1Body: No matter how elegant your code, a paycheck caps your upside.
slots.insight2Body: Ownership turns the same effort into asymmetric returns over time.
slots.insight3Body: You don't hate your job; you hate paying rent on someone else's dream.
slots.pullQuote: I wasn't tired of coding; I was tired of coding for cap table leftovers.

slots.title: Be the glue
slots.subtitle: The founder's job is to hold product, sales, and story together.
slots.insight1Body: Deep expertise matters, but breadth builds billion-dollar companies.
slots.insight2Body: AI and contractors handle specialties; you handle the seams.
slots.insight3Body: Only the founder holds enough context to make zero-to-one decisions.
slots.pullQuote: I stopped trying to be the best engineer and started being the irreplaceable founder.

slots.ctaBody: AI didn't kill your job—it killed the illusion that you ever wanted one. Start building equity.
